procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b). The request was submitted as competitor declaration. It was recategorized as a request for redress.
facts: On the downwind leg 3 of the outer loop, GER 217521 was observed by a jury observer making body movements causing the boat to roll.
The were no wind or wave pattern to explain the movements.
The jury gave yellow flag penalty in accordance with appendix P2.2
conclusions: There was no error or omission by the Jury.
Since the penalty was not due to the failure to take into account a race committee signal or a class rule, GER 217521 is not entitled to redress as provided by RRS P4.
